sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: GRT LKS/OH VLY TROUGH WILL PROGRESS SLOWLY E THROUGH FRI AS SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW OVER OH SHEARS NNE INTO WRN QUE AND UPSTREAM DISTURBANCE NOW IN MN CONTINUES SE INTO IND. FARTHER W...UPR LOW ALONG THE BC CST SHOULD ELONGATE EWD INTO AB...ENHANCING WSW FLOW OVER THE NRN RCKYS...AND DEAMPLIFYING DOWNSTREAM RIDGE OVER THE NRN PLNS. ELSEWHERE...NHC FCSTS HRCN ARTHUR TO GRAZE THE NC CST AS IT ACCELERATES NNE AND...LATER...NEWD THROUGH EARLY FRI. AT LWR LVLS...MORNING ANALYSES SHOW SECONDARY COLD FRONTAL SURGE /ASSOCIATED WITH OH UPR IMPULSE/ NOW NEARING THE WRN SLOPES OF THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. THIS BOUNDARY SHOULD CONTINUE E INTO CNTRL PORTIONS OF NY/PA...AND INTO WRN MD/VA LATER TODAY...OVERTAKING OLDER/WEAKER BOUNDARY STALLED OVER THE REGION. IN THE WEST...LEE CYCLONE/TROUGH WILL STRENGTHEN OVER MT AS WLY FLOW INCREASES ALOFT.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC/NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SFC HEATING OF VERY MOIST /PW 1.75-2.00 INCHES/...MODERATELY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT SHOULD PROMOTE ANOTHER ROUND OF NUMEROUS DIURNAL STORMS ALONG AND AHEAD OF CNTRL/NRN APPALACHIANS COLD FRONT. DEVELOPMENT LIKELY ALSO WILL BE FOSTERED BY NNE-MOVING OH UPR IMPULSE. WIND PROFILES OVER THE REGION ARE SLIGHTLY STRONGER BUT SOMEWHAT BACKED RELATIVE TO YESTERDAY...WITH 35-40 KT SWLY DEEP SHEAR EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THIS EVE FROM WRN/NRN VA NEWD INTO WRN/NRN NEW ENGLAND. OVERALL SETUP APPEARS SIMILAR TO YESTERDAY...WITH THE GREATEST OVERLAP OF BUOYANCY AND DEEP SHEAR FAVORABLE FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS SHIFTED A BIT SWWD INTO CNTRL/ERN PA AND SERN NY. UPSCALE ORGANIZATION OF THE CONVECTION INTO CLUSTERS/BANDS APPEARS LIKELY...WITH A RISK FOR DMGG WIND...MARGINALLY SVR HAIL...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO.

sections.title: NC CST TODAY THROUGH EARLY FRI
sections.text: LATEST NHC FCST TRACK FOR HRCN ARTHUR WILL ALLOW QUADRANT OF THE CIRCULATION MOST FAVORABLE FOR LOW-LVL MESOCYCLONE DEVELOPMENT TO AT LEAST GRAZE THE FAR ERN PARTS OF NC LATER TODAY INTO TNGT. UPDRAFTS IN THE INITIAL OUTER CONVECTIVE BANDS NOW AFFECTING THE CAPE FEAR/CAPE LOOKOUT AREA APPEAR TO LARGELY BE OUTFLOW-DRIVEN. HOWEVER...CELLS WITH A GREATER LOW-LVL MESOCYCLOGENESIS POTENTIAL MAY MOVE/DEVELOP NWWD INTO THE AREA A BIT LATER TODAY THROUGH TNGT AS ENVELOPE OF MORE SHELTERED HIGH THETA-E AIR MORE DIRECTLY ASSOCIATED WITH ARTHUR NEARS THE CST /REF MCD 1260/. GIVEN STRENGTH OF LOW-LVL SHEAR...QUALITY OF LOW-LVL MOISTURE...AND THE PROXIMITY OF THE GULF STREAM STORM UPDRAFTS...A CONDITIONAL RISK MAY DEVELOP FOR TORNADOES AND/OR WATERSPOUTS.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS/ADJACENT HIGH PLNS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH FLATTENING OF DOWNSTREAM NRN PLNS RIDGE WILL PROVIDE MODEST LARGE SCALE ASCENT ACROSS ID/MT TODAY AS LEE TROUGH/LOW-LVL PRESSURE GRADIENT SOMEWHAT STRENGTHEN. ASCENT ALSO MAY BE ENHANCED IN NRN MT BY TAIL END OF UPR IMPULSE LIFTING NEWD INTO AB. MOISTURE WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY SPARSE...WITH PW AROUND 0.75-1.00 IN. BUT COUPLED WITH STRONG DIFFERENTIAL HEATING OF ELEVATED TERRAIN AND STEEP LOW TO MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...EXPECT SCTD AFTN TSTMS OVER THE REGION. 25-30 KT WLY DEEP SHEAR MAY SUPPORT WEAK UPSCALE ORGANIZATION INTO SMALL CLUSTERS/BANDS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND...ESPECIALLY...LOCALLY DMGG WIND GIVEN WELL-MIXED SUB CLOUD LAYERS. FARTHER S...ISOLD TO SCTD DRY TSTMS MAY OCCUR FROM THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION ACROSS THE ERN GRT BASIN TO THE FOUR CORNERS AND NRN AZ...WHERE A TRANSITION TO MORE MOIST...SW-U.S. MONSOON-TYPE OF CONVECTION IS EXPECTED OVER SRN AZ AND NM. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/03/2014

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER PARTS OF THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND NEW ENGLAND...WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THE MAIN THREATS. FARTHER SOUTH...HURRICANE ARTHUR MAY PRODUCE A COUPLE TORNADOES OVER COASTAL AREAS OF NORTH CAROLINA. ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ALSO MAY OCCUR OVER THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS...AS WELL AS OVER NORTHERN FLORIDA AND SOUTHERN GEORGIA. ISOLATED STRONG WINDS COULD ALSO MATERIALIZE OVER ARIZONA.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ALONG THE NC COAST
sections.text: AMENDED TO ADD ISOLATED WIND TO ARIZONA

sections.title: NRN FL/SRN GA
sections.text: A HIGHLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS NRN FL/SRN GA IS OVERTURNING IN A ZONE OF WEAK CONFLUENCE WITH STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ONGOING. TALL STORMS WITH HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT IN AN OTHERWISE WEAK FLOW ENVIRONMENT SHOULD CONTINUE TO FAVOR LOCALLY SEVERE WET MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL UP TO 1 INCH DIAMETER THROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN AZ
sections.text: STORMS ARE BEGINNING TO FORM ALONG THE RIM AND ACROSS SERN AZ. CONTINUED STRONG HEATING WILL REDUCE CIN AND EVENTUALLY ALLOW THESE STORMS TO PROPAGATE IN A SWWD DIRECTION LATER TODAY. THE LARGE T/TD SPREADS AND DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER MAY SUPPORT AN ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE WIND GUST. ..JEWELL.. 07/03/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1127 AM CDT THU JUL 03 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CENTER OF STRENGTHENING HRCN ARTHUR WILL MOVE OVER THE CAPE FEAR COASTAL WATERS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. EXPECT THE CHANCE FOR STRONGER CONVECTIVE WIND GUSTS AND ISOLATED WATERSPOUTS AND/OR TORNADOES TO INCREASE ACROSS THE COASTAL AREAS FROM CAPE FEAR TO CAPE LOOKOUT OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EYE OF HRCN ARTHUR WAS LESS THAN 100NM SOUTH-SOUTHEAST OF MYR/CRE SC BASED ON 15Z NHC FIX. LEADING BAND OF CONVECTION HAS SPREAD INLAND ACROSS NERN SC AND CAPE FEAR OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. STRONGER REFLECTIVITY CORES WITHIN THIS LEADING BAND HAVE EXHIBITED LITTLE ORGANIZATION AND SPARSE LIGHTNING...POSSIBLY DUE TO BEING REMOVED FROM STRONGER WIND FIELD ASSOCIATED WITH THE HRCN CIRCULATION. A SECOND OUTER CONVECTIVE BAND WAS CURRENTLY APPROACHING CAPE FEAR FROM THE SOUTH AT ABOUT 30-35KT WITH SOME OF THE STRONGER CELLS SOUTHEAST OF THE CAPE EXHIBITING LIGHTNING...OCCASIONAL WEAK ROTATION...AND EVEN LINEAR/BOWING STRUCTURES. LATEST KLTX VWP DEPICTS 35-50KT DEEP-LAYER SELY FLOW IN THE 1-5KM LAYER RESULTING IN GREATER THAN 200 M2/S2 EFFECTIVE SR-HELICITY FOR STORMS TRACKING FROM THE SOUTHEAST AT 25-30KT. CURRENT INDICATIONS SUGGEST AN INCREASE IN TSTM WIND GUSTS...PERHAPS APPROACHING SEVERE...AS STRONGER WINDS ABOVE THE SURFACE MIX DOWN VIA CONVECTIVE TURBULENCE. WITH TIME... STRENGTHENING SR-HELICITY WILL EXPAND NORTHWARD/NORTHEASTWARD COINCIDENT WITH INCREASING INSTABILITY NEAR THE COAST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THIS WILL OCCUR AS THE DEEP-LAYER CYCLONIC WIND FIELDS INTENSIFY WITH THE APPROACH OF THE HRCN. THUS...WHILE INITIAL ACTIVITY POSES SOME CHANCE FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS...STRONGER AND MORE PERSISTENT CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS WITHIN THE OUTER BANDS OF THE HRCN WILL LIKELY POSE AN INCREASING THREAT FOR WATERSPOUTS AND TORNADOES. THIS POTENTIAL SHOULD INCREASE LATER THIS AFTERNOON NORTHEAST OF CAPE FEAR TO CAPE LOOKOUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SCATTERED SEVERE TSTMS WITH HIGH WINDS AND SOME HAIL ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE FROM NRN VA ACROSS ERN PA AND INTO SERN NY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE COORDINATED FOR THESE AREAS WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MODEST MID-LEVEL TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 30-50KT SWLY WINDS ALOFT WILL SPREAD EAST FROM THE OH VALLEY AS A WEAK SURFACE COLD FRONT MOVES EAST FROM THE APPALACHIAN CREST THIS AFTERNOON. LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE TROUGH AND FRONT WILL ACT ON A VERY MOIST AND INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS THE REGION. WHILE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE MODEST...MAGNITUDE OF LARGE SCALE ASCENT...WEAK CAPPING...AND PRE-CONVECTIVE SURFACE HEATING WILL LIKELY OFFSET LAPSE RATE LIMITATIONS TO SUPPORT NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. GREATER EFFECTIVE VERTICAL SHEAR IS SOMEWHAT DISPLACED TO THE NORTH AND WEST OF GREATER POTENTIAL INSTABILITY. THUS EXPECT A MIXED MODE OF CONVECTIVE CHARACTER WITH MORE PERSISTENT SUPERCELL/ORGANIZED STORM POTENTIAL POSSIBLE AT THE INTERFACE OF STRONGER SHEAR AND INSTABILITY...FROM PA TO NY/NJ...AND MORE MUTLICELL/CLUSTERED STORMS TO THE SOUTH. EVENTUALLY...STORM MERGERS AND LINEAR FORCING NEAR THE FRONT MAY RESULT IN AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR LINE SEGMENTS AND LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL AROUND THE HOURS OF MAXIMUM HEATING LATER THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE PROSPECTS FOR SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON FROM THE DELAWARE AND HUDSON VALLEYS NORTH AND EAST ACROSS THE CONNECTICUT RIVER VALLEY. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE LIKELY FOR SOME OF THESE AREAS IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT WILL SETTLE SEWD FROM NORTHEAST NY AND NORTHERN NEW ENGLAND THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACCOMPANIED BY WEAK MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NORTHEASTWARD FROM THE GREAT LAKES/OH VALLEY. IN ADDITION TO LIFT ALONG THE ADVANCING FRONT AND NEAR WEAK FRONTAL WAVES... DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN WILL AID CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT WELL AHEAD OF THE FRONT AMIDST A WEAKLY CAPPED AND INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS. VERTICAL SHEAR ON THE ORDER OF 30-50KT WILL FAVOR A FEW SUSTAINED ROTATING UPDRAFTS/SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED TO SCATTERED HAIL AND STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...ALONG WITH AN ISOLATED/BRIEF TORNADO. WITH TIME...STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO LINE SEGMENTS NEAR/ALONG THE FRONT WITH POTENTIALLY MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS ACCOMPANYING AN EASTWARD-MOVING SQUALL LINE FROM NRN NJ/ERN NY INTO WRN NEW ENGLAND BY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MIX OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE MULTICELLS AND TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF A LARGE HAIL/DMGG WIND THREAT WILL CONTINUE AS THE SEVERE THREAT GRADUALLY SHIFTS EWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY OVER THE PAST HR HAS SHOWN A SPLITTING PAIR OF SUPERCELLS OVER SERN PA AND OTHER TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES OVER NRN VA AND INTO CNTRL PORTIONS OF NY. THE AMALGAMATION OF COLD POOLS ASSOCIATED WITH LINE SEGMENTS OVER W-CNTRL VA AND CNTRL PA WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE WRN DELIMITER FOR APPRECIABLE STRONG/ISOLD SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. A SEVERE WIND GUST /57 KT/ WAS MEASURED AT KIPT AROUND 1930Z ASSOCIATED WITH PASSAGE OF THE CNTRL PA LINE SEGMENT. THE AIRMASS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE LINE SEGMENTS AND INTO THE WARM SECTOR FROM VA NWD INTO NY...IS CHARACTERIZED AS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /1000-2000 J PER KG MLCAPE/. THE STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW IS LARGELY CONFINED TO FAR NRN VA NWD INTO NY ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR INCREASING WITH NWD EXTENT /35 KT IN NRN VA TO 50 KT IN CNTRL NY/ WILL LIKELY SUPPORT A CONTINUED MIX OF BOTH STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE MULTICELLS AND SUPERCELLS. WEAKER TROPOSPHERIC FLOW OVER CNTRL VA SWD TOWARDS THE NC BORDER WILL LIKELY LIMIT THE MAGNITUDE OF SEVERE TO PERHAPS A FEW POCKETS OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE. ..SMITH.. 07/03/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: EYE OF HURRICANE ARTHUR WILL SKIRT CAPE FEAR NC SOON. ISOLATED TORNADO AND/OR WATERSPOUT CHANCES WILL LIKELY PEAK ACROSS THE CAPE FEAR AREA NORTH TO WRIGHTSVILLE BEACH OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AND THEN INCREASE NORTH TO CAPE LOOKOUT WITHIN 2-3 HOURS AND BEYOND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE CENTER OF HURRICANE ARTHUR IS WELL DEPICTED FROM A NUMBER OF RADAR SITES ALONG THE SOUTHEAST U.S. COAST THIS AFTERNOON...AS WELL AS GOES VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY. A PORTION OF THE NORTHERN EYEWALL OF ARTHUR WILL SOON MOVE OVER THE SOUTHERN TIP OF CAPE FEAR AND KLTX VWP DATA WAS OBSERVING A RAPID INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL SHEAR WITH 50KT OF EASTERLY FLOW WITHIN 1KM OF THE SURFACE. MEANWHILE...CONVECTIVE FEEDER BANDS CONTINUE TO ORBIT THE CENTER OF ARTHUR WITH HIGHER REFLECTIVITY CORES CONFINED PRIMARILY TO THE EASTERN SEMI-CIRCLE OF THE HURRICANE CIRCULATION. EXPECT ISOLATED TORNADO/WATERSPOUT POTENTIAL TO PEAK EAST OF ILM IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO WHILE THIS POTENTIAL LIKELY INCREASES NORTHEASTWARD TO MHX AS STRONGER CONVECTION AND STRENGTHENING SHEAR EXPAND NORTHEASTWARD OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. MOST OF THE DISCRETE STRONGER CORES WITHIN THE FEEDER BANDS HAVE EXHIBITED ONLY WEAK ROTATION SO FAR. HOWEVER...ANY PERSISTENT DISCRETE ELEMENTS TRACKING NWWD ACROSS THE COASTLINE WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE BRIEF WATERSPOUTS AND/OR TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS POSING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...HAIL...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO...WILL INCREASE ACROSS WESTERN PORTIONS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 391 OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. MORE ISOLATED STORMS WITH SOME WIND AND HAIL POTENTIAL WILL ALSO CONTINUE OVER EASTERN AREAS OF THE WATCH...PRIMARILY OVER NORTHEAST MA AND WESTERN MAINE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AMPLE INSTABILITY WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ROBUST THUNDERSTORMS AHEAD OF A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT AND FRONTAL WAVE/LOW FROM THE MOHAWK VALLEY OF NY SOUTH INTO EASTERN PA AND NORTHERN NJ. OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...MOST SUPPORTIVE JUXTAPOSITION OF FORCING/SHEAR AND STRONGER INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY CONTRIBUTE TO SEVERE STORMS SPREADING EAST ACROSS THE CATSKILLS OF NY TOWARD THE HUDSON VALLEY...AND FROM THE HUDSON/MOHAWK VALLEYS...EAST INTO PORTIONS OF WESTERN VT. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS APPEAR POSSIBLE ALONG A CORRIDOR OF STRONGER INSTABILITY FROM NORTHEAST PA AND NORTHERN NJ NORTHEASTWARD TO PARTS OF CT/MA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE FORECAST TO CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING THE COVERAGE/POTENTIAL FOR COLD POOLS TO CONGEAL THAT COULD POTENTIALLY RESULT IN A SWATH OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS INTO THE LOWER DESERTS EARLY THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER THE WHITE MTNS IN ERN AZ WITH A SEPARATE AREA OF ISOLD STORM ACTIVITY OVER SERN AZ. TEMPS HAVE WARMED TO AOA 100 DEG F IN THE LOWER DESERTS NEAR THE GREATER PHOENIX METRO. THE 20Z GPS PW OBSERVATIONS NEAR PHX AND TUS SHOWED RELATIVELY HIGH PW VALUES...1.5 AND 1.3 INCH RESPECTIVELY. BOTH MODIFIED 12Z PHOENIX AREA AND TUS RAOBS...AS WELL AS RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS...SHOW DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER PROFILES WITH VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES. ALTHOUGH TROPOSPHERIC FLOW IS GENERALLY WEAK...MODEST ELY/S /15-20 KT/ IN THE 2-5 KM ARL LAYER AT KEMX AND WLY HIGH LEVEL FLOW MAY SERVE TO PROMOTE PROPAGATION OF STORMS INTO THE LOWER DESERTS FROM ERN AND SERN AZ. IF LARGE ENOUGH STORM CLUSTERS CAN GENERATE COPIOUS AMOUNTS OF CONGEALING OUTFLOW...SOME POSSIBILITY FOR GREATER COVERAGE OF ISOLD STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS COULD MATERIALIZE. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED OVER THE NEXT FEW HRS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE SLOWLY INCREASING ACROSS PARTS OF WRN/CNTRL MT. THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL...BUT COVERAGE OF THESE THREATS MAY BE INSUFFICIENT FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE COMBINATION OF DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION /MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1000 J/KG/ AND INCREASING OROGRAPHIC AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ACCOMPANYING AN UPPER IMPULSE MOVING OUT OF WRN ID IS FOSTERING AN INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE OVER THE PAST COUPLE HRS. INITIAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS LARGELY REMAIN ANCHORED TO THE HIGHER TERRAIN...BUT SHOULD QUICKLY SPREAD TO LOWER ELEVATIONS/HIGH PLAINS THROUGH THE EVENING HRS AMIDST THE PRESENCE OF 20-30 KT OF WLY FLOW. LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS QUITE WEAK /5-15 KT/...BUT STEEP 0-4 KM AGL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS...ESPECIALLY IF SMALL LINE SEGMENTS CAN CONGEAL. THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGER SWATHS OF STRONG-SVR WINDS WILL BE MONITORED...BUT CURRENT INDICATIONS SUGGEST THIS THREAT WILL REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN A THREAT ACROSS THE VALID PORTION OF WW 391...WITH COLD POOLS ENHANCING THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT. COUNTIES IN THE WAKE OF THE STRONGER BANDS OF STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO HAVE A DIMINISHING SEVERE WEATHER THREAT AS THE AIR MASS IS CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED...AND THUS COULD BE CANCELLED FROM THIS WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY /REFLECTIVITIES AND VELOCITY/ INDICATED AT LEAST TWO COLD POOL ENHANCED LINES OF STORMS...1/ MOVING EWD FROM SRN VT INTO CENTRAL/SRN NH AT 40+ KT...AND 2/ MOVING NEWD AT 40+ KT INTO CENTRAL/NRN NJ FROM ERN PA. THIS LATTER LINE PRODUCED A 57 KT WIND GUST AT KPNE IN SERN PA AT 2317Z. ADDITIONAL STRONG-SEVERE BANDS OF STORMS EXTENDED FROM SWRN MA/NWRN CT INTO SERN NY AND NRN NJ. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWED A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY REMAINING IN PLACE FROM NJ NEWD THROUGH CT...WRN/CENTRAL MA...NH TO WRN ME. THE AFOREMENTIONED STORMS ARE MOVING INTO THIS CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT ORIENTED PARALLEL TO THE CONVECTION...SUPPORTING A CONTINUED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND SHEAR...HAIL REMAINS A THREAT...AND EFFECTIVE SRH AROUND 100 M2/S2 COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR UP TO 40 KT SUPPORT AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. ..PETERS.. 07/03/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STABILIZING EFFECTS OF ONGOING AND EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS SWRN INTO CENTRAL VA SUPPORTS A CONTINUED DIMINISHING TREND IN THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. THE REMAINING COUNTIES WITHIN WW 389 COULD BE REMOVED FROM THIS WATCH PRIOR TO THE 01Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN RADAR IMAGERY AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED AN OVERALL DIMINISHING TREND IN THE STRENGTH OF STORMS ACROSS SWRN VA. THIS COMBINED WITH WARMING CLOUD TOPS SUGGESTS THE OVERALL POTENTIAL FOR NEW STRONG-SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS QUITE LOW...SUPPORTING THE LIKELIHOOD THAT WW 389 CAN BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO THE SCHEDULED 01Z EXPIRATION. ..PETERS.. 07/04/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT SLOWLY NWD ACROSS EAST CENTRAL AND NERN NC INTO SERN VA THROUGH THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT...AS HURRICANE ARTHUR TRACKS NNEWD PER LATEST NHC FORECAST/GUIDANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSES/RADAR IMAGERY AND NHC DATA INDICATED THE 01Z POSITION OF HURRICANE ARTHUR NEAR 45 SM E OF ILM. GIVEN A NNEWD MOVEMENT OF THIS STORM SYSTEM...THE THREAT FOR TORNADOES WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT NWD ACROSS EAST CENTRAL AND NERN NC INTO SERN VA THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. RECENT TORNADO WARNINGS HAVE INCLUDED AREAS JUST WNW OF WW 390 IN VICINITY AND NE OF KRWI WHERE STREAMLINE ANALYSES INDICATED A N-S ORIENTED WIND SHIFT THAT EXTENDED FROM NEAR KGSB TO KRWI TO KRIC. A ZONE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDED EAST THROUGH NORTH OF ARTHUR WITH THE OUTERMOST BAND OF TSTMS MOVING NWD INTO THIS UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH SFC-1 KM SHEAR OF 20-35 KT IN THE ERN/NRN PORTION OF ARTHUR WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATIONS/TORNADO THREAT INTO THE OVERNIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES TO SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE REMAINING PORTION OF WW 391...WITH COUNTIES IN MAINLY MA...NH...AND WRN ME POTENTIALLY NEEDING TO REMAIN IN THIS WATCH BEYOND 02Z. LOCAL TEMPORAL EXTENSION FOR THIS WATCH IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A QUASI-LINEAR BAND OF STRONG-SEVERE TSTMS EXTENDING FROM FAR WRN ME THROUGH ERN NH...CENTRAL MA...CENTRAL CT TO LONG ISLAND. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED A GENERAL DIMINISHING TREND IN AVAILABLE INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...FORWARD PROPAGATING BOWING LINES ARE LIKELY BEING MAINTAINED BY COLD POOLS AND COMPENSATING FOR THE DIURNAL REDUCTION IN INSTABILITY. THUS...LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE BEYOND 02Z...MAINLY ACROSS PARTS OF MA...ERN NH AND WRN ME SUCH THAT A LOCAL WFO EXTENSION OF WW 891 IS POSSIBLE. ..PETERS.. 07/04/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES WITHIN THE NRN AND ERN PARTS OF HURRICANE ARTHUR AS THIS STORM SYSTEM TRACKS TOWARD THE NORTHEAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0445Z...RADAR MOSAIC INDICATED THE CENTER OF HURRICANE ARTHUR NEAR 35 WSW HSE...WITH LATEST NHC FORECAST GUIDANCE SHOWING A NEWD MOVEMENT. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING FROM THE ERN PART OF ARTHUR INTO NERN NC AND SERN VA. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE SRH OF 200-300 M2/S2 ARCING FROM THE ERN PORTION OF ARTHUR INTO NERN NC MAINTAINS THE POTENTIAL FOR LOW-LEVEL ROTATION/ATTENDANT TORNADO THREAT INTO THE OVERNIGHT. COUNTIES WEST OF A LINE FROM 50 SE EWN-25 N EWN-30 ENE RZZ ARE EXPECTED TO HAVE LESS OF A TORNADO THREAT AS SURFACE WINDS IN THESE AREAS ARE FROM THE NORTH...RESULTING IN WEAKER EFFECTIVE SRH. ..PETERS.. 07/04/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THOUGH A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT NEXT COUPLE HOURS MAINLY OVER EXTREME SERN VA AND THE VA EASTERN SHORE...OVERALL THREAT APPEARS MARGINAL. ANOTHER WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AFTER THE EXPIRATION OR CANCELLATION OF WW 392.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING THE CENTER OF HURRICANE ARTHUR WAS LOCATED NEAR CROATAN SOUND NC MOVING NE AT 15-20 MPH. SEE LATEST ADVISORIES FROM NHC FOR MORE DETAILS ON ARTHUR. THE VWP DATA FROM WAKEFIELD SHOW LOW-LEVEL SHEAR HAS INCREASED BUT REMAINS UNIMPRESSIVE. THE MORE FAVORABLE NERN QUADRANT FOR TORNADOES WITH STRONGER 0-1 KM SHEAR AND GREATER INSTABILITY WILL REMAIN OFFSHORE AS ARTHUR CONTINUES NEWD THIS MORNING. POORLY ORGANIZED SEMI-DISCRETE CELLS LOCATED IN ONE OF THE OUTER BANDS ARE MOVING WWD INTO SERN VA AND THE VIRGINIA EASTERN SHORE...AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH THIS ACTIVITY. THE HURRICANE IS FORECAST BY NHC TO CONTINUE NEWD AWAY FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST THIS MORNING DUE TO THE INFLUENCE OF A PROGRESSIVE MID-LATITUDE TROUGH LOCATED OVER THE OH VALLEY. THEREFORE...ANY REMAINING TORNADO THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO WANE THROUGH THE MORNING HOURS. ..DIAL.. 07/04/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
